steps.note: Create the trigger function that keeps amount and total equal on every insert/update (takes no lock on orders).
steps.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION orders_sync_amount_total() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$ BEGIN IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN IF NEW.total IS NULL THEN NEW.total := NEW.amount; ELSIF NEW.amount IS NULL THEN NEW.amount := NEW.total; END IF; ELSIF NEW.amount IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.amount AND NEW.total IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.total THEN NEW.total := NEW.amount; ELSIF NEW.total IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.total AND NEW.amount IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.amount THEN NEW.amount := NEW.total; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $f$;

steps.note: Add nullable column total (metadata-only, instant) and the sync trigger in one transaction. 200ms lock_timeout with retries so live queries never queue long behind the lock.
steps.sql: DO $retry$ DECLARE n int := 0; BEGIN PERFORM set_config('lock_timeout', '200ms', true); LOOP BEGIN ALTER TABLE orders ADD COLUMN total numeric(10,2); CREATE TRIGGER orders_sync_amount_total BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION orders_sync_amount_total(); EXIT; EXCEPTION WHEN lock_not_available THEN n := n + 1; IF n >= 100 THEN RAISE; END IF; PERFORM pg_sleep(0.3); END; END LOOP; END $retry$;

steps.note: Backfill total = amount for ids 1..1000000 in 10k-row batches, each committed on its own.
steps.sql: DO $bf$ DECLARE b bigint := 1; hi bigint := 1000000; BEGIN WHILE b <= hi LOOP UPDATE orders SET total = amount WHERE id >= b AND id < LEAST(b + 10000, hi + 1) AND total IS NULL; COMMIT; PERFORM pg_sleep(0.02); b := b + 10000; END LOOP; END $bf$;

steps.note: Vacuum so this chunk's dead row versions get reused instead of bloating the table.
steps.sql: VACUUM orders;

steps.note: Backfill ids 9000001..max(id). This covers every row inserted before the trigger existed; rows inserted since get total from the trigger.
steps.sql: DO $bf$ DECLARE b bigint := 9000001; hi bigint := (SELECT max(id) FROM orders); BEGIN WHILE b <= hi LOOP UPDATE orders SET total = amount WHERE id >= b AND id < LEAST(b + 10000, hi + 1) AND total IS NULL; COMMIT; PERFORM pg_sleep(0.02); b := b + 10000; END LOOP; END $bf$;
VACUUM orders;

steps.note: Check that every row has total equal to amount. If not, the plan stops here, before anything irreversible.
steps.sql: DO $chk$ BEGIN IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders WHERE total IS DISTINCT FROM amount) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'orders.total does not match orders.amount'; END IF; END $chk$;

steps.note: Add NOT NULL as a NOT VALID check constraint (instant; short lock with retries).
steps.sql: DO $retry$ DECLARE n int := 0; BEGIN PERFORM set_config('lock_timeout', '200ms', true); LOOP BEGIN ALTER TABLE orders ADD CONSTRAINT orders_total_not_null CHECK (total IS NOT NULL) NOT VALID; EXIT; EXCEPTION WHEN lock_not_available THEN n := n + 1; IF n >= 100 THEN RAISE; END IF; PERFORM pg_sleep(0.3); END; END LOOP; END $retry$;

steps.note: Validate the check constraint. This scans the table under SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE, which doesn't block reads or writes.
steps.sql: ALTER TABLE orders VALIDATE CONSTRAINT orders_total_not_null;

steps.note: SET NOT NULL on total. There's no table scan because Postgres uses the validated check. Then drop the now-redundant check (short lock with retries).
steps.sql: DO $retry$ DECLARE n int := 0; BEGIN PERFORM set_config('lock_timeout', '200ms', true); LOOP BEGIN ALTER TABLE orders ALTER COLUMN total SET NOT NULL; ALTER TABLE orders DROP CONSTRAINT orders_total_not_null; EXIT; EXCEPTION WHEN lock_not_available THEN n := n + 1; IF n >= 100 THEN RAISE; END IF; PERFORM pg_sleep(0.3); END; END LOOP; END $retry$;

steps.note: Roll the app over to reading and writing total. During the rollout, old pods write only amount and new pods write only total. The BEFORE trigger fills in the other column, so both NOT NULL columns stay valid and equal.
Give terminating old pods (30 s grace period) time to finish in-flight requests that still use amount.
Check again that total equals amount for every row before dropping anything.
steps.sql: DO $chk$ BEGIN IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders WHERE total IS DISTINCT FROM amount) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'orders.total does not match orders.amount'; END IF; END $chk$;

steps.note: Drop the sync trigger, the old amount column and the function in one short transaction (short lock with retries).
steps.sql: DO $retry$ DECLARE n int := 0; BEGIN PERFORM set_config('lock_timeout', '200ms', true); LOOP BEGIN DROP TRIGGER orders_sync_amount_total ON orders; ALTER TABLE orders DROP COLUMN amount; DROP FUNCTION orders_sync_amount_total(); EXIT; EXCEPTION WHEN lock_not_available THEN n := n + 1; IF n >= 100 THEN RAISE; END IF; PERFORM pg_sleep(0.3); END; END LOOP; END $retry$;

steps.note: Clean up the last dead row versions and refresh planner statistics.
steps.sql: VACUUM ANALYZE orders;
